comments.body:
Thanks for the fix! **merge-train (2026-11-07):** validated, and it rides this run.

I pushed one mechanical commit to your branch (`60f0c8f9c`): `tests/unit/test_ent591_template_source_bound.py` pins `crud._LOCAL_TEMPLATE_NAME_RE` as the policy pattern wrapped in `^…$`, so it went red with the new `\Z` anchor. It now expects `\Z`. I've also approved the CI runs for your fork.

Not in this issue's scope, just notes for a possible follow-up sweep: the same `^…$` + `.match` shape remains in `crud._GITHUB_REPO_PATH_RE` / `_GITHUB_REF_RE` / `_CRED_FILE_PATH_RE`, `system_service._MANIFEST_ID_RE`, `skill_packaging.SKILL_NAME_RE`, `lifecycle._SKILL_NAME_RE`, `credential_destination.AGENT_NAME_RE` and the event-type patterns in `event_subscriptions.py`. The new tests could also pin the message with `pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid ...")`.
